title: cycas circinalis subsp. riuminiana
intro: Cycas circinalis subsp. riuminiana, commonly known as the Sri Lankan cycad, is a species of plant in the family Cycadaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities. The therapeutic actions of Cycas circinalis subsp. riuminiana are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of this plant for human use.
